_comment: Buy-back (trade-in) pricing policy for the AI valuation on sell requests.
Unlike repair-pricing.json — a literal price list per service — a trade-in has no fixed
sheet: what a used device is worth depends on its model and the current UAE second-hand
market. So this file encodes the POLICY the model must apply on top of the market price it
estimates: how much we deduct for condition and age, what margin we need to resell it, and
the hard limits we never quote outside of.
Tune these numbers on the server via the sell.pricing.path property — no redeploy needed.

margin._comment: Fraction of the estimated resale (retail-refurbished) price we keep. offer = resale x (1 - target_margin), then condition + age multipliers are applied.

condition_multiplier._comment: Applied to the market value of the same model in good used condition.

age_multiplier._comment: By age since purchase. Use the closest bracket; interpolate when the purchase date is known precisely. If no purchase date is given, assume 2-3 years and lower confidence.

category_floor_aed._comment: Below these we don't buy at all — say so plainly instead of quoting a token amount.

deductions_aed._comment: Flat deductions stacked on top of the multipliers, for defects visible in the photos or stated by the customer.

hard_rules._comment: Non-negotiable. Breaking any of these makes the valuation useless to procurement.
never_buy: devices that are iCloud / Google account locked
devices with no working display AND no power
